verdict.rationale: Unleash documents environments as stages of the development lifecycle, and a flag can be enabled in development or test without being enabled in production, which gives independent per-environment flag states. Backend API tokens are scoped to one or more projects and a single environment, and separate frontend tokens are safe to expose client-side, so SDK keys are environment-scoped. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the environment and token scoping behavior, and clarity on environment-count limits across editions (only the hosted tier is stated to have unlimited environments).
